The '''Crescent Canyon Laboratory''' was a laboratory built by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] as part of their [[Crescent Canyon Facility]] on the [[Crescent Canyon Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] confronted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]] there and retrieved the stolen [[thermal bore]] device.
